Pixel art game VFX sprite sheet for a small tactics game: chunky square pixels, hard edges, no anti-aliasing, NO outline around light, dust, petals, sparkles or rings, BRIGHT colours (each shape lit with its lightest shades and a white core - it must read on a dark battlefield), colours only from a pink bloom ramp (#FFFFFF, #FFE0F0, #FF9AD0, #F04AA8, #B8075E), a blue-violet dream ramp (#FFFFFF, #E6E8FF, #A8B0FF, #6A6AE8, #3A2C9A) and leaf-green accents (#E8FFD0, #B1DC43, #3E8A2A, #036A2E) used sparingly.
Effect: PRANCING PETALS under a figure's hooves, 4 frames, a seamless loop, SYMMETRIC LEFT TO RIGHT in every frame, square for square (the game never mirrors it on the red side): a faint blue-violet ground glow 20 squares wide and 3 tall, 4 pink petals and 4 motes rising from it at mirrored places, two short pale speed streaks at each side (mirrored); the petals rise 1 square a frame and fade in again at the bottom.
Layout: one horizontal row of 4 equal 28:10 cells, image size 1792x160 (each cell 448x160, 16 px a square); centered across, the glow on the cell's bottom. Transparent background (if not possible: pure black #000000). No gaps, no borders, no labels.
Production constraints: this is ONLY an effect, no character. Exactly 4 separate temporal frames, one horizontal strip with equal cell aspect 28:10. The logical pixel grid of EACH cell is exactly 28 columns by 10 rows. Render large SOLID aligned SQUARE pixel blocks, one block per logical pixel. Do not draw a smooth illustration or countless tiny pixels. All forms must fit completely within their individual cell and never touch adjacent frames. Do not add any outer canvas margins. Transparent RGBA canvas. No soft halos, dark outlines, checkerboard, text or scenery. Preserve a clean empty central area for hollow rings/auras. Reference is only color and silhouette inspiration; create original low-resolution VFX, do not paste its textures.
